notes: Core-Lean proof A217319_main: P-positions of Mark-4 (moves n -> n-1, n-2, n-3, floor(n/4)) are 0 and n = 4^(2k+1) m with 4 not dividing m; via A217319_noPP (no move between P-candidates) and A217319_toP (every other n moves into one). Known: Fraenkel 2012 for all Mark-t, as stated in Guo arXiv:1108.1239 Sec. 2. Outside Lean: that the move relation transcribes Fraenkel's Mark-4 and that A217319's binary description equals odd 4-adic valuation.

prior_art.note: Guo (2011) states P-positions of Mark-t = numbers with odd trailing-zero count in base t, citing Fraenkel; Fraenkel's paper not read directly.
